hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Verify two local invariants: every cell equals the cell directly below it, and every cell differs from the cell directly to its right.

hints.title: Down Neighbor Invariant
hints.text: For each row r < m - 1 and column c, check if grid[r][c] == grid[r + 1][c].

hints.title: Right Neighbor Invariant
hints.text: For each row r and column c < n - 1, check if grid[r][c] is distinct from grid[r][c + 1]. Return false on any violation.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass inspecting down and right neighbors.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Not applicable; single scan is already minimal.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Check neighboring grid boundaries and invariants cleanly.
